verdict.rationale: AutoGen's install pattern (autogen-ext[openai]) hints at a pluggable model-client architecture that could support swapping providers, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents multiple model client implementations (e.g., Azure, Anthropic, local models) or a documented API for swapping without code changes. missing for 10: explicit docs on model_client abstraction/interchangeable providers, hands-on example switching providers, independent confirmation of portability.
